title: [Stream] stablehlo.while: loop-carried resource is deallocated on the branch into the loop (transient buffer has not been committed
body:
Failure of  `stablehlo.while` in simple programs:

```python
import numpy as np
import iree.compiler as ireec
import iree.runtime as rt

SRC = """
func.func @main(%n: tensor<i32>) -> tensor<i32> {
  %c1 = stablehlo.constant dense<1> : tensor<i32>
  %init = stablehlo.constant dense<1> : tensor<i32>
  %r = stablehlo.while(%iterArg = %init) : tensor<i32>
   cond {
    %p = stablehlo.compare LE, %iterArg, %n, SIGNED : (tensor<i32>, tensor<i32>) -> tensor<i1>
    stablehlo.return %p : tensor<i1>
  } do {
    %a = stablehlo.add %iterArg, %c1 : tensor<i32>
    stablehlo.return %a : tensor<i32>
  }
  return %r : tensor<i32>
}
"""

vmfb = ireec.compile_str(SRC, target_backends=["llvm-cpu"],
                         input_type="stablehlo_xla",
                         extra_args=["--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu=generic"])

cfg = rt.Config("local-task")
ctx = rt.SystemContext(config=cfg)
ctx.add_vm_module(rt.VmModule.copy_buffer(cfg.vm_instance, vmfb))
ctx.modules.module["main"](rt.asdevicearray(cfg.device, np.array(5, dtype=np.int32)))
```

```
ValueError: Error invoking function:
  iree/hal/local/transient_buffer.c:80: FAILED_PRECONDITION;
  transient buffer has not been committed; ensure the alloca signal semaphores
  are satisfied before accessing it; while invoking native function
  hal.fence.await; while calling variadic import;
  [ 0] bytecode module@2:1080
```

Expected `6`.

## Versions
| | |
|---|---|
| `iree-base-compiler` / `iree-base-runtime` | **3.12.0rc20260831** (`3d0c17b9a5`) |
| OS / arch | Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS, x86_64, kernel 5.4.0-171-generic |
| target | `llvm-cpu`, `local-task`, `--iree-llvmcpu-target-cpu=generic` |
| driven via | `iree.compiler` and `iree.runtime` Python APIs |
